name: Wind Fan
description: A painted silk fan that stirs a breeze even when it is still.
body:
## What it does

As an action you can cast gust of wind from it. Once used, it should rest until dawn: each use before then has a 20 percent chance, adding up, of failing and tearing into rags.

spells.name: Gust of Wind
spells.note: once per dawn; each further use before dawn has a growing 20 percent chance to tear the fan
